decisions.rationale: Capoworks ECU corrected the Boost blend tables menu: the "Closed loop 1 adder" entry now opens the first closed-loop blend table (boostClosedBlend1Table) instead of the second. No tune values change and no migration is needed; regenerate or use the TunerStudio INI that matches the installed firmware, then verify which blend table each menu entry opens before editing.

last_sync.summary: Capoworks ECU now stores the maximum knock retard load bins as 16-bit values from 0 to 1000 with no fixed percent unit, so pressure-based loads above 250 kPa can be distinguished and loads above the last bin clamp to the final table row. The tune layout changes and the flash data version advances to 20033, so older binary tunes reset and the knock table and axes must be transferred with the matching TunerStudio INI. The two merge commits add no further user-facing change beyond the audited child commit.

decisions.rationale: Capoworks ECU changed the maximum knock retard load bins from 8-bit percent values capped at 250 to 16-bit values from 0 to 1000 with no fixed unit. Pressure-based loads above 250 kPa are now distinguishable, and loads above the final bin clamp to the final table row. This changes the tune layout and advances the flash data version to 20033, so older binary tunes reset; record the knock table and its load/RPM axes before flashing and recreate them with the matching generated TunerStudio INI. The change is covered by unit tests only and has not been validated on an engine.
